scope: P2.1 online acquisition with a real OpenAI-compatible LLM as the only teacher

learning_mode.teacher_labels: LLM decisions from successful episodes only
learning_mode.primary_compiler: periodic supervised recompile with held-out shadow validation

time_to_reflex.definition: validated novel-family episodes before the first promotion representing the family

amortization.note: Online acquisition spends no extra LLM tokens on compilation: teacher labels come from deliberative calls the LLM-only baseline also pays for. Token savings are therefore net from the first reflex use. The only extra cost is local compile and validation wall-clock, compared here against cumulative LLM latency saved.

limitations: Single model, single seed, one 69-episode stream in the full run. Not a robust estimate.
Supervised imitation of LLM decisions from successful episodes only. No credit assignment, no RL.
The compiled reflex covers tool-control decisions. apply_fix remains a validated repair primitive.
